abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 5. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 12.2 | 6.1 | 750 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 12.0 | 6.0 | 750 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 12.2 | 6.1 | 750 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
